name: Essential Pass

validity.notes: 339 days' entry per year (not full year); has ~25 blackout/exclusion dates across Dec 2025-Dec 2027, listed in full terms

notes: Covers 20+ UK Merlin attractions (Alton Towers, Thorpe Park, Chessington, LEGOLAND Windsor plus non-park venues like SEA LIFE not tracked in this dataset). No separate child/concession price shown on pricing page; children under ~0.9m tall may enter free without their own pass per general Merlin policy, but this pass page doesn't confirm that. Adult-only price shown.
